dynamic_context_semantics.active_context_initialization: active context starts as the initial tail window
per_repeat_sequence: scan every current active-context entry using compact checksum fields
append stream blocks to the full logical transcript
rebuild active context to the latest rolling tail window
continue the next repeat against the updated active context
dynamic_context_semantics.invariant_status: both B2q and R0q satisfy final logical block count and active-context entry-visit invariants

mechanism_interpretation.primary_claim: P5-Q validates the dynamic active-context workload axis. Both B2q and R0q preserve rolling-tail active-context semantics, final logical block count, and bounded rendered DOM. R0q shows only a small end-to-end proxy advantage over B2q, while moving dynamic active-context update work into Worker. The main finding is bottleneck localization, not R0q dominance.
mechanism_interpretation.b2q_mechanism: B2q performs rolling-tail active-context rebuild, tail mutation, append, compact scan, and bounded DOM update on the main thread.
mechanism_interpretation.r0q_mechanism: R0q performs rolling-tail active-context rebuild, tail mutation, append, compact scan, and bounded projection generation in Worker, then commits a bounded projection on the main thread.
mechanism_interpretation.bottleneck: rolling-tail active-context rebuild is a material cost in both systems
mechanism_interpretation.caveat: R0q does not make dynamic update cost disappear; it moves the update into Worker and keeps the bounded main-thread commit explicit.
mechanism_interpretation.missing_measurement: P5-Q does not measure input availability while dynamic active-context update is running.

optimization_implications.comparison_rule: Algorithmic optimizations must be paired if used for B2q/R0q comparison.
optimization_implications.next_evidence_axis: Architecture-specific value should be tested through input availability during dynamic update.

supports: dynamic active-context is a real new workload axis
rolling context update is a material cost
R0q moves this cost into Worker
next test should examine input availability while dynamic update runs
does_not_prove: dynamic update advantage in input responsiveness
